name: rn-sdk
description: RN 화면을 AAR 과 XCFramework 로 빼기 위한 SDK 소스

scripts.bundle:android: react-native bundle --platform android --dev false --entry-file index.js --bundle-output android/rnsdk/src/main/assets/index.android.bundle --assets-dest android/rnsdk/src/main/res
scripts.bundle:ios: react-native bundle --platform ios --dev false --entry-file index.js --bundle-output ios/RnSdk/Resources/main.jsbundle --assets-dest ios/RnSdk/Resources
